sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. The leaders will be heavy favourites against bottom-placed Alsager, who have managed just 4 points from 10 games and are winless in their last five outings. Sandbach themselves come into the fixture off the back of a recent loss but remain in strong form overall with 7 wins in their last 10 games.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town (20 points) travel to Dawley Town in a key fixture for maintaining their title-race position, while third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a clash between two of the division's stronger sides. Wolverhampton Casuals, level on 19 points with AFC Bridgnorth, face a trip to Wednesfield Community. Bilston Town (5th, 17 points) host Foley Meir in a mid-table contest. Among the struggling sides, Shawbury United—currently on a run of six consecutive losses—host Barnton, while Brereton Social entertain pointless Widnes Town and Crewe face Allscott Heath. Cheadle Heath Nomads, with just 7 points, travel to Market Drayton Town in a lower-table battle, and New Mills head to Market Drayton Town to face the hosts in a fixture between two mid-table sides.
